previous_disclosures.summary: AMD's server CPU portfolio includes the 4th Gen AMD EPYC 9004 Series built on the Zen 4 5nm process, the 3rd Gen AMD EPYC 7003 Series, and the AMD EPYC 97x4 (Bergamo) optimized for cloud native computing using the Zen 4c core. The portfolio also features the AMD EPYC 8004 Series (Siena), also built on the Zen 4c core, and includes processors with AMD 3D V-Cache technology for technical computing workloads.

comparisons.peer_summary: Intel launched Intel Xeon 6 processors for data centers using Intel 3 process and Efficient cores, designed to address diverse workload deployments. The 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors, based on Intel 7, continued to ramp throughout 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel are active in the data center CPU market, but they differ in their specific product generations and architectural focus for the 2024 fiscal year. AMD highlights the announcement of its 5th generation AMD EPYC family to expand its high-performance server CPU portfolio. In contrast, Intel focused on the launch of the Intel Xeon 6 processors (utilizing Intel 3 process and Efficient cores) while continuing to ramp its previously launched 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors (based on Intel 7).

sentences.text: We recently announced our 5th generation AMD EPYC family of server processors, further expanding our high-performance server CPU portfolio.

▪Data center CPUs. We launched our Intel® Xeon® 6 processors for the data center, utilizing the Intel 3 process, including our first Intel Xeon processor using Efficient cores (E-cores). The Intel Xeon 6 family is designed to address the growing diversity in workloads and deployments in the data center environments. Our 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors, based on Intel 7, were launched in 2023, and continued to ramp throughout 2024.

Similarly, NVIDIA notes that its data center platform expanded to include CPUs in fiscal year 2024, allowing the company to optimize across the entire computing, networking, and storage stack for data center-scale solutions.
